title: Stream call audio to your own server
summary: tap sends a copy of a call's audio to a WebSocket or RTP destination of yours, and stop_tap ends it by control id. The same pair exists mid-call over REST as calling.tap and calling.tap.stop.
scenario: A workshop that wants every support call's audio on its own server, live

evidence: schema.json Tap: uri required (rtp://, ws://, wss://), direction speak|listen|both, codec PCMU|PCMA, control_id; StopTap.control_id
tools/openapi/rest.json calling.tap variant: control_id, tap{type audio, params}, device oneOf ws{uri, codec}|rtp{addr, port, codec, ptime}; calling.tap.stop
